summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature. rich/progress.py: private _Reader (RawIOBase + BinaryIO) with byte accounting on all read paths, seek via Progress.update, write raising UnsupportedOperation; private _ReadContext for start/stop ordering; module-level open and wrap_file plus a shared display-building helper placed after track(); Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file placed after track(). tests/test_progress.py: 12 new tests. docs/source/progress.rst: two new subsections. CHANGELOG.md: one Unreleased/Added entry. Nothing was committed. Tests, black, isort, and mypy were not run (read-only verification only). Unverified: Python 3.6 compatibility of the multiple-inheritance reader class; one '# type: ignore' on the readinto handle call.
